import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.anomaly_experiments.sentinel import sentinel_write

# Deep complex path for ~2.5 est
deep_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/plasticity/deep/level1/level2/level3/level4/level5/level6/level7/long_complex_filename_d3.txt'
content = 'DEEP_D3' * 2  # Small payload

result = sentinel_write(deep_path, len(content), content)
print(f"D3 deep op result: {result}")
